    Lemma 6.3(2) with Ext from graded projective resolutions #

    positive-deformations.tex: internal degree t in Ext means degree-t maps from a graded projective resolution, and Ext^n_{A₀}(M_i, M_j)_t = 0 for n ≥ 1, t > −2n. Every M_i has a graded projective resolution (exists_gres_ev), and for every one of them the Ext computed from it vanishes in the stated range (extVanish_ev_res), by the comparison with the bar Ext (GExt.GRes.extVanish_iff) and the bar form of the lemma (extVanish_ev).

    Rs.ExtVanish (gmodEv D hfin j) n t

    Lemma 6.3(2) (lem:positive-ext-vanishing), with Ext as in the manuscript: for every graded projective resolution of M_i, the Ext^{n+1}_{A₀}(M_i, M_j)_t computed from it vanishes for t > −2(n+1), and for all t when M_i is projective.
